reason: This plugin is a user-facing workflow orchestration utility for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, centered on managing what happens when the agent is busy. Evidence shows it is a Cordis client-side extension (no core source edits) that reimplements busy-input behavior with a three-level steering model (now/next/later), adds an in-console queue management panel, and includes freeze/resume controls; therefore its primary purpose is orchestrating interaction flow rather than generating code, accessing files, or connecting external services.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的客户端插件，在发送输入时提供三档（立即/下一轮/排队）控制，并可冻结与恢复会话队列，帮助用户管理对话中的消息处理顺序。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness web client plugin that adds three-mode input steering (now/next/later) plus queue management with freeze and resume controls to help users organize how pending messages are processed.

capabilities: Injects a web client plugin into DeepSeek Harness to intercept busy-Enter behavior and reroute message dispatching.
Adds a queue dock for managing pending user inputs (reorder, edit, retract, clear) during active conversation flow.
Supports session freeze/recover controls that temporarily remove queued text from active submission and restore it later.

reasons.code: The plugin registers client-side slots/injected components and shadows existing queue/setting UI entries, changing how user input is submitted and scheduled.
Readme describes now/next/later modes (interrupt/insert-later/requeue), explicit cancel→remove→resend flow, queue reordering, editing, and clear-all actions affecting pending messages.
Readme documents session freeze/resume that manipulates pending queue state via existing session update/send/cancel calls and stores frozen text locally in plugin state.
